errors.text_span: Die x-Achse beschreibt die Differenz ländlicher zu städtischen Räumen
errors.evidence: The x-axis represents the years from 2013 to 2022. 'Differenz ländlicher zu städtischen Räumen' is the label below the axis, describing the overall context of the plot, not what the axis itself represents.
The markers for the 'Unbereinigt' (black) line are diamond-shaped, not round.

errors.text_span: Beginnt die Linie bei einem Wert von etwa 0,6 im Jahr 2013
errors.evidence: The black line ('Unbereinigt') starts at a value of approximately 0.5 in 2013, not 0.6.

errors.text_span: und behält dann bis 2018 einen ähnlichen Wert bei. Ab 2018 sinkt sie auf etwa 0,5 im Jahr 2022
errors.evidence: This description of the trend for the black line is incorrect. It ignores a significant dip in 2017. Furthermore, from 2018 the line rises to a peak of 1.0 around 2019-2020 before declining. It does not simply sink from 2018. The final value in 2022 is also incorrect; it is approximately 0.8, not 0.5.
The markers for the 'Bereinigt' (blue) line are triangles, not squares.

errors.text_span: steigt auf einen Spitzenwert von etwa 0,4 im Jahr 2016
errors.evidence: The blue line ('Bereinigt') does not rise to a peak of 0.4 in 2016. In fact, it drops below zero in 2016. The highest value reached by this line is approximately 0.15 in 2015.
